name: Raoul Garland
source:
"...I'm sure I'll make you the strongest familiar!"

A magician who controls familiars. He's an oddball who treats half-humans and half-demons like full humans. Surprisingly, he's still a rather logical person.

[Translated from [url=https://www.pandora.nu/kuro/game/tukai/t_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
